prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE finished PHOTOREALISTIC minimalist product catalogue photograph, portrait 3:4, ideally 1086 x 1448.
Provided image is the approved MASTER for the exact Earl Grey Matcha Latte drink identity, real packaging, mascot and typography. Preserve this product and overall header design, adapt only the simple scene and camera/light specified below.
ONE short squat broad transparent sundae cup, rounded base, clear dome lid properly seated. Exactly the same compact front girl-and-rabbit "128am Cafe" sticker: brown-haired smiling girl, white rabbit with exactly TWO ears, legible brand. Whole cup and lid in frame with comfortable margins.
Keep THIN amber-brown Earl Grey syrup band at the very bottom, only about 4–5% of liquid height like the master. Above it creamy beige Earl Grey infused milk, natural rich green matcha with realistic marbling and ice, smooth soft cold foam lightly dusted with matcha fully inside the dome. No piped whipped cream tower, no extra ingredients.
CRITICAL clean packaging: no spills, overflow, wet green smears, residue or external drips anywhere on the cup, rim or dome. Exterior flange crystal clear, transparent and clean, properly seated lid. Foam and drink are entirely inside. Fine realistic condensation on cup body is acceptable, no large messy beads.
Minimalism is essential: one cup, plain simple background, restrained natural shadow, generous negative space. NO PROPS of any kind, no tea, bowls, leaves, fruit, flowers, cloth, plants, framed windows, patterns, furniture, platforms, pedestals, utensils or decorations. No illustration or CGI.
Exact text on TWO centered lines: "earl grey" then "matcha latte". Same bold rounded Fredoka-style lowercase type as master, muted rose #B8496C. Small "128am Cafe" directly beneath, same rounded font without exaggerated tracking. Preserve master header layout, central alignment and generous safe top margin. No other text, prices, badges, claims or watermarks.
Natural appetising exposure, bright creamy beige and natural green colours. Brand ivory #FFF8F5, blush #FDE5EB, sage #E7F0DC. Studio food photography, realistic plastic, accurate optics, soft dimensional natural light.
Scene: Plain pastel blush background and blush surface. A SINGLE broad very soft rectangular LIGHT patch enters from outside the frame onto the background, subdued low contrast. No window, frame, grid or object visible; light alone. One clean centered cup with small natural shadow. Composition variation: cup at a gentle three-quarter angle turned about 10 degrees to camera, label still readable, positioned a little right of centre beneath the centered header. Full product width about 48% of canvas. Lighting patch is gentle and unobtrusive.
Framing priority for this variation: cup centre at 61% of canvas width, not centered; whole cup safely inside frame. Three-quarter side lighting and the softly luminous rectangular patch fill the left negative space. Header remains centered.
visual_qa: Passed: one full right-offset cup/no props, correct text and mascot, thin amber syrup band, clean exterior flange and contained foam.

correction.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: minimalist Earl Grey catalogue photo with cup positioned right of centre. Image 2 is the TYPEFACE MASTER only.
Make ONE targeted correction to Image 1: replace only its heading typography with the exact SAME HEAVY BOLD ROUNDED Fredoka-like letterforms and stroke weight used by Image 2. Image 1 heading is too thin. Match the noticeably plumper bold master shapes, including single-storey lowercase a, round wide letters, soft corners, and thick stems. Match master title size/width and centered positioning at top.
Exact text is TWO lines: "earl grey" then "matcha latte". Small "128am Cafe" below, same rounded style. Keep existing muted rose #B8496C palette and ample safe margins. No other text.
CRITICAL: preserve ALL of Image 1's photograph and composition unchanged: right-offset full clear dome sundae cup, girl/two-ear bunny label, thin 4–5% amber syrup at base, beige milk/green matcha/contained smooth foam, clean transparent rim/flange, pale pink seamless set, subtle soft light patch on left, shadows and lighting. Do not move/recenter/resize the cup. Do not add props or change product. This is only a typography correction. Portrait 3:4 same size. Photorealistic photo.
correction.reason: Match title font weight to master while preserving photograph.
correction.visual_qa: Corrected heavy rounded title, original off-centre photograph retained; full cup/no props/thin syrup/clean rim passed.
